OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_KEYWORD_EXCLUDE.des: Moves the card into the Exclude Pile. It cannot be recovered by normal means.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_KEYWORD_CHOICE.desc: When played, choose one of several effects.
At the end of your turn, if this card is still in your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Exclude[/gold] it.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_KEYWORD_REWIND.desc: Return to the state at the start of the previous turn: restore HP, Block, and power stacks, and enemies' intents along with them. On relics that track a counter, steps the counter back by one turn.
Fast-forward to the state of the next turn: on yourself, resolve the duration-based powers you have; on an enemy, advance its intent. On relics that track a counter, advances the counter by one turn.
Exhaust the Status cards in your hand. [gold]Magma Body[/gold] heals 2 HP for each card Incinerated.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_KEYWORD_DETONATE.de: Remove all [gold]Burn[/gold] from the target and deal extra damage based on the stacks Detonated, then the stacks are consumed.
OTHERWORLD_TREASURES_KEYWORD_CLEANSE.des: Remove [gold]Burn[/gold] from the target without dealing Detonate damage; the stacks are consumed.
